root_cause_label: Signature Mismatch and Import Side-Effects via Guard Removal
one_sentence_failure_summary: The agent implemented run_tasks with a list[T] return type instead of the required None, and later removed the if __name__ == '__main__' guard, causing import side effects — neither issue was ever noticed or corrected.
t_err_evidence: Step 2 writes run_tasks with return type '-> list[T]' and returns 'await asyncio.gather(...)'; the spec requires return type None. The agent never verified the required signature before writing.
t_commit_evidence: The incorrect list[T] return type is written in step 2 and never corrected in any subsequent rewrite (steps 7, 9, 12, 15 all preserve the same wrong signature). The agent spends steps 3-18 exclusively on KeyboardInterrupt testing, never revisiting the return type.
trigger_explanation: The agent never reads or verifies the required function signature from the task spec before implementing. It assumes the function should return the list of task results (list[T]) rather than None, and proceeds to build and test around this incorrect assumption throughout the entire trajectory.
